description: This file initializes the React application by rendering the root component 'App' into the DOM element with id 'root'. It also imports necessary modules including React, ReactDOM, global styles, and the main App component.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root container for a React application in the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React element into the root container.
